statement: Human neural stem cells grafted into the injured primate spinal cord survived, differentiated and extended large numbers of axons over long distances into the host cord, with modest forelimb functional improvement.

measurement.effect: extensive graft-derived axon growth; modest functional improvement

limitations: functional improvement modest and secondary to the anatomical readout

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (Crossref/Europe PMC), checked 2026-09-14; no source opened at figure level
